resources.string: Share files directly between Android devices and Tauri desktop applications over your local Wi-Fi or LAN without cloud uploads or accounts.
Send files to nearby devices on your local network
Receive files from nearby devices without cloud servers
Pair quickly with desktop or mobile devices using a QR code
Make sure both devices are connected to the same Wi-Fi or local network.
Share files directly between your devices. Fast, private and without cloud uploads.
Camera access is needed only to scan pairing QR codes from nearby devices. You can also paste pairing payloads manually without camera access.
Notifications alert you when another device wants to send files and show real-time transfer progress.
Nearby Wi-Fi permission allows LocalDrop to discover compatible Android and desktop devices on your local network without requesting location access.
View nearby LocalDrop devices and live LAN discovery status
Quickly send files to a favorite or recent LocalDrop device
Monitor active and completed LocalDrop transfers
